chunks: These qualities are incumbent upon you. So, you should acquire them and excel each other in them. Even if you cannot acquire them you should know that acquiring a part is better than giving up the whole.
ai.seo_question: What is the Islamic approach to acquiring good character if one cannot master all virtues?
ai.summary: In this passage from *Nahj al-Balagha*, Imam Ali (AS) provides a pragmatic approach to spiritual development, acknowledging human limitation in mastering all virtues simultaneously. He encourages believers to compete in acquiring good character (*khala'iq*) while emphasizing that partial adherence is superior to total neglect, a concept known as *al-kathir min al-af'al khayr min tarkihi*. This reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on gradual self-purification (*tazkiyah*) and the practical application of ethics in daily life.
